sum: CID HoldCo, Inc. operates as an electric vehicle car-sharing and fleet management company. The company provides electric vehicle car-sharing services for residential, commercial, municipal, and hospitality properties that include fleet management, technology integration, insured vehicles, customer support, maintenance, pricing, and roadside assistance. It also offers services, such as parking spots, installed charging stations, and a mobile app for vehicle access and management. The company supplies data analytics and usage monitoring for property managers and supports integration with public and private sector partners. It manages operational aspects, such as cleaning, insurance, and customer service. It serves property owners and managers of residential complexes, student housing, hospitality properties, corporate workplaces, and municipality sectors. The company was incorporated in 2024 and is based in Las Vegas, Nevada. As of June 10, 2026, CID HoldCo, Inc. operates as a subsidiary of BladeRanger Ltd.
